item.title: Boaters Urged To Prepare as New Water Safety Campaign Launches
item.description: Boaters across the UK are being urged to prepare for the new season as HM Coastguard, the RNLI and the RYA launch a safety campaign promoting preparation, training and onboard safety checks. The post Boaters Urged To Prepare as New Water Safety Campaign Launches appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Calls for Action Over Royal Mail Delays Ahead of Scottish Election
item.description: Concerns have been raised over Royal Mail delays ahead of the Scottish Parliament election, with warnings that ongoing postal problems could affect the delivery of election materials and postal votes across rural Scotland.The post Calls for Action Over Royal Mail Delays Ahead of Scottish Election appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Weather App Forecasts Blamed for Lost Visitors at Highland Wildlife Park
item.description: Highland Wildlife Park and Edinburgh Zoo say misleading weather app forecasts predicting all day rain are reducing visitor numbers, prompting calls for clearer forecasts to help people make better decisions about outdoor plans.The post Weather App Forecasts Blamed for Lost Visitors at Highland Wildlife Park appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Farm Costs Rising as Global Tensions Push Up Fertiliser and Fuel Prices
item.description: NFU Scotland has warned that rising fertiliser and fuel costs linked to global tensions could threaten farm production and food security, urging the UK Government to act to support farmers and stabilise supply.The post Farm Costs Rising as Global Tensions Push Up Fertiliser and Fuel Prices appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Willie Campbell Back With Timely New Single ‘Holiday From Myself’
item.description: Isle of Lewis musician Willie Campbell will release his first solo single in more than two years when Holiday From Myself arrives on 20 March, marking a reflective new chapter for the former Astrid songwriter.The post Willie Campbell Back With Timely New Single ‘Holiday From Myself’ appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Cancer Patients To Benefit From Expanded Single Point Of Contact Support
item.description: Cancer patients across Scotland will benefit from expanded Single Point of Contact support after successful pilot projects showed improved patient experience and freed specialist clinical time within NHS cancer services.The post Cancer Patients To Benefit From Expanded Single Point Of Contact Support appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Art Exhibition Celebrates Creativity of Children With Learning Disabilities
item.description: An exhibition at Eden Court in Inverness celebrated the artwork of children with learning disabilities from across the Highlands, highlighting creativity, community and the importance of inclusive spaces for young people and families.The post Art Exhibition Celebrates Creativity of Children With Learning Disabilities appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Automotive Industry Calls for Rethink on UK Electric Vehicle Transition
item.description: The UK automotive industry is calling for an urgent review of the country’s electric vehicle transition as rising battery costs, higher energy prices and slower demand challenge current targets.The post Automotive Industry Calls for Rethink on UK Electric Vehicle Transition appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Peaceful Bungalow in the Village of Halkirk
item.description: Heatherlea in Halkirk is a two bedroom detached bungalow set within generous gardens and featuring a large workshop, offering peaceful village living just seven miles from Thurso in Caithness.The post A Peaceful Bungalow in the Village of Halkirk appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Wildlife Park To Host Easter Bricktastic Beasts Trail
item.description: Highland Wildlife Park will host the Bricktastic Beasts trail from 3 April to 30 May, featuring more than 25 life sized animal sculptures built from over 558,000 colourful bricks.The post Highland Wildlife Park To Host Easter Bricktastic Beasts Trail appeared first on The Highland Times.
